lines.text: The priests and diviners tell the Philistines to send the ark back with five gold tumors and five gold rats.
The men put the ark on the cart, and the cows head straight up the road toward Shiloh.
The people harvesting wheat see the ark, chop up the cart, and offer the cows as a burnt offering.
The five rulers return to Gath that same day, after the Philistines sent one gold tumor for each city.
God strikes down seventy men who looked inside the ark, and the men of Kiriath-jearim take it into Abinadab's house.
